speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs since October 2016 (a) to what extent are users of legal online gambling sites operated by Singapore Pools and Singapore Turf Club current gamblers on any platform versus first-time gamblers; and (b) whether such gamblers have used these sites to add to their total gambling spending as opposed to switching gambling spending from other platforms.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Just one very quick supplementary question: may I know the source of the data for the first part of the answer on the proportion of users who previously had telephone betting accounts?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The sources are Singapore Pools and Singapore Turf Club themselves.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: The information is from surveys done on the users of their services.
